summary: llm-d is a Kubernetes component. deploying 6 workload(s) (llm-d-coordinator, fma-requester, render, render, interactive-pod, mooncake-master-store) with 7 container(s). exposing 7 service(s) on ports: 50051, 50052, 8000, 8080, 9003. with 1 HorizontalPodAutoscaler(s). runtime dependencies: OpenTelemetry Collector, Redis. with 10 ingress route(s). Python k8s client with 2 API call(s). integrates with Istio, Prometheus via labels/annotations. mounts 2 ConfigMap(s) as volumes: llm-d-coordinator-config, mooncake-master-store-config.
